why: I43's contract (tests_m3/test_theory_core2.py rules C1 and C2, preregistered at the I43 prereg 84c185f) requires holon/gen/theory2.py to emit theory core II's Bend and Lean statements, frozen in the I43 instrument, verbatim as fixed text. Both texts name the second natural transformation of Thm 6.7 (vertical composition) eta2: the Bend law core_nat_vcomp binds -eta2: T -> U and the Lean theorem thm_6_7_b binds (eta2 : T → U), and the proofs use it. eta2 is a generic identifier of the theorem, but M1's facts also name a migration eta2, so the scan of string literals in every holon module (identifiers() over spec/M1/facts) finds it in theory2.py, and no tree could satisfy both this assertion and I43-R12. The amendment adds exactly "holon/gen/theory2.py": ["eta2"] to ALLOWLIST, as the existing "kappa" exceptions do for a mathematical name; every other M1 identifier stays forbidden there and everywhere else, and holon/gen/theory2.py must still pass I43's own genericity check (tests_m3/test_theory_core2.py::TestHonesty.test_generic_code). Until holon/gen/theory2.py lands, test_listed_files_exist reports it missing.
